modules.description: Inji Certify at https://certify.inji.test:18450, harness run 20261014T140148Z-9643eb

failures.message: Found invalid entries in OID4VCI Credential Issuer metadata input

Unknown properties were found in the OID4VCI Credential Issuer metadata. This may indicate the sender has misunderstood the spec, or it may be using extensions the test suite is unaware of. If these are known extensions, add their names to the 'vci.allow_unexpected_credential_issuer_metadata_fields' array in the test configuration to suppress this warning. If they are derived from a specification, please open an issue at https://gitlab.com/openid/conformance-suite/-/work_items/new (or, if you are unable to, email certification@oidf.org) so the test suite can be updated.

Unknown properties were found in the OAuth Authorization Server metadata. This may indicate the sender has misunderstood the spec, or it may be using extensions the test suite is unaware of. If these are known extensions, add their names to the 'server.allow_unexpected_metadata_fields' array in the test configuration to suppress this warning. If they are derived from a specification, please open an issue at https://gitlab.com/openid/conformance-suite/-/work_items/new (or, if you are unable to, email certification@oidf.org) so the test suite can be updated.
failures.block: Verify OAuth Authorization Server Metadata Response

benchmark.comment: Inji Certify writes logo, background_color, background_image and text_color of credential_metadata.display as null when a credential configuration does not set them; the metadata schema allows a string or an object, not null (measured 2026-10-14).

Warning that follows the null display values: the suite then reports scope, cryptographic_binding_methods_supported and proof_types_supported of the SD-JWT configuration as unknown, together with credential_definition and credential_signing_alg_values_supported of the ldp_vc configuration FarmerCredential (measured 2026-10-14).
The credential configuration FarmerCredential uses the ldp_vc format of Appendix A.1; suite release-v5.3.1 validates only SD-JWT VC and mdoc configurations and warns about every other format.

Inji Certify publishes interactive_authorization_endpoint and require_interactive_authorization_request, which come from a later OpenID4VCI draft (interactive authorization); suite release-v5.3.1 does not know them and warns.
benchmark.current_block: Verify OAuth Authorization Server Metadata Response

failures.message: Couldn't find content-type header in endpoint_response
If present, a string is expected for credential_issuer_metadata_endpoint_response body but JsonNull was found

benchmark.comment: Signed credential issuer metadata is optional and Inji Certify does not offer it: asked with Accept: application/jwt it answers the unsigned JSON document.
Follows from the unsigned answer: there is no JWT to decode, so the suite stops the module (INTERRUPTED with result FAILED).
